thread:
sasha: Heads up — ~5% of eu-west-ingress pods are failing mTLS handshakes since 09:12 UTC. Hunt started. Seeing KMS decrypt denies for keystore id ks-789.

omar: dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west shows the spike.

sasha: Logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-23T09:12:18Z ingress-proxy[pid=42]: handshake error: unwrap failed: KMSAccessDenied: Caller is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789:key/ks-789
    principal=service-account:ingress-keystore
```

kelly: Did we just roll an RBAC change that touched keystore roles this morning? @matt merged a couple of PRs, right? :thinking_face:

matt: yeah i merged #8245 (keystore-role-tighten) at 08:55 UTC. It tightened the keystore Unwrap role to a narrower principal set. I was trying to reduce blast radius. rolling back now.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0034 — assigned to sasha. Priority P2. :rotating_light:

omar: also noticing the KMS audit export for eu-west shows a gap 09:10-09:20 (no CloudTrail events). could be audit-exporter misconfig or region replication lag. worth checking immediately.

sasha: Triage plan (short):
1) rollback RBAC tighten
2) run keystore unwrap canary against a single ingress pod
3) verify KMS audit stream resumed and capture missing-window artifacts
4) if rollback fails, failover ingress to eu-central routing policy

Executing rollback:
```bash
kubectl apply -f rbac/keystore-access-rollback.yaml --context=prod-eu-west
# then
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress-proxy -n infra
```

kelly: if we need to failover, we can flip `service-routing/eu` to prefer eu-central. Example: `redwoodctl routing set ingress eu prefer-region=eu-central`

matt: rollback applied at 09:24 UTC. kube rollout restarted. ran unwrap canary:
```
[09:26:02] canary-unwrap: unwrap success for ks-789 principal=ingress-canary-sa
```

audit-bot: Audit export resumed at 09:34 UTC. Missing window 09:10-09:20 flagged and retained for RCA.

sasha: Good first pass. Follow-ups: @omar please own the RCA (capture timeline + audit gap), @kelly please add an automated RBAC canary test for keystore unwrap in the CI checklist, @matt please add a gating item to PR template to require keystore role canary run. we'll schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

omar: on it. also proposing a new alert: `kms.unwrap.denied.rate` > 0.5% sustained for 5m in a region -> page eng-sre. should help catch this before user-visible impact.

sasha: ACK. closing incident for now but leaving RCA tracking open. thanks all. :heart:
